source.source_name: Sudski registar (Court Register) — Open Data API
source.attribution: Izvor: Sudski registar (Ministarstvo pravosuđa), Otvorena dozvola.

access.note: Free registration at sudreg-data.gov.hr -> Client ID/Secret + token + Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key (Oracle APIM). Open licence; not paid. Test env: sudreg-data-test.gov.hr.

pagination.note: subjekt list endpoint supports offset/limit paging; subjekt detail by tipIdentifikatora (oib|mbs) + identifikator. Confirm exact paths from the OpenAPI (sudreg-podaci.pravosudje.hr/docs/services).

parsing.notes: oib/mbs stay strings. temeljni_kapital EUR since 2023 (HRK before). osobe are PII (members + management). predmet_poslovanja carries NKD where coded. Confirm exact JSON field names from the OpenAPI.

fixture_requirements: d.o.o. with osobe (member + uprava) + temeljni_kapital + NKD
subjekt looked up by OIB vs by MBS

live_test_plan.smoke: With SUDREG_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY, GET subjekt by tipIdentifikatora=oib&identifikator=<oib>; assert mbs + oib + tvrtka + status.
live_test_plan.full: Behind SUDREG_* env gate, page the subjekt list (offset/limit); persist raw JSON; normalize the spine keyed on OIB/MBS; join FINA RGFI financials on OIB.

blockers: Free registration required for the subscription key (Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key).
Exact JSON field names / endpoint paths to confirm from the OpenAPI.
